visual_goal: Show many content writers flowing through adapters (wholesale feeds via mapping first) into one canonical store with provenance; media, translation and quality write back; guests read only read models.
prompt: A left-to-right flow illustration. Far left, three source boxes stacked: a laptop labeled 'Extranet', a plug labeled 'Content APIs', and a stack of files labeled 'Bedbank files'. 'Bedbank files' sends one arrow into a matching box with two puzzle pieces labeled 'Mapping'. One arrow each from 'Extranet', 'Content APIs' and 'Mapping' into a funnel labeled 'Source adapters'. One arrow from the funnel into a large central vault with small source tags on its drawers labeled 'Canonical store'. Above the vault, three small worker boxes, a photo frame labeled 'Media', a speech bubble pair labeled 'Translation' and a check badge labeled 'Quality', each connected to the vault by a two-way arrow. At the far right, a screen showing a property page labeled 'Read models', with one arrow from the vault into it.
alt: Extranet, content APIs and bedbank files (through mapping) feed source adapters into a canonical content store; media, translation and quality services write back; read models publish to guests.

visual_goal: Show the mapping pipeline: a supplier file is normalized and scored, scores split into auto-match, human review or new property by threshold, then the registry and room mapping make a room sellable.
prompt: A left-to-right pipeline illustration. Far left: a document labeled 'Supplier file', one arrow into a box with a comb icon labeled 'Normalize', one arrow into a balance scale labeled 'Scoring'. From 'Scoring' three arrows fan out to three stacked boxes: top green 'Auto-match' with arrow label '0.95', middle orange 'Human review' with a person-at-desk icon and arrow label '0.75 to 0.95', bottom blue 'New property' with arrow label 'below 0.75'. 'Human review' sends one arrow up into 'Auto-match' and one arrow down into 'New property'. 'Auto-match' and 'New property' each send one arrow into a register book labeled 'Mapping registry'. One arrow from the registry into a box with a door icon labeled 'Room mapping', and one final arrow from it to a shop window labeled 'Sellable'.
alt: A supplier file normalized and scored, split by thresholds into auto-match, human review or new property, recorded in a mapping registry, then room-mapped before it becomes sellable.
